# Contributing

This project is governed by the [Fabric Engineering OS Constitution](../CONSTITUTION.md).

The full contribution guide is maintained at [`community/CONTRIBUTING.md`](../community/CONTRIBUTING.md). This file exists so GitHub surfaces contribution guidance from the issue and pull request UI.

Before contributing:

- Read the [Constitution](../CONSTITUTION.md) and [Governance](../GOVERNANCE.md).
- Report security concerns through the [Security Policy](../SECURITY.md).
- Record OS-canon, wiki, and upstream changes as a proposal issue first.
- Remember that humans approve pull requests, perform merges, and own all production actions.
